statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-9506 is a regular-expression denial of service in the Vue 2 template compiler. The only fix is Vue 3 (https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-9506). Dependency-Track Frontend ships Vue 2.7.16 with the runtime compiler in the bundle, so the vulnerable code is present. A major upgrade is pending upstream.
